footnotes: From pre-tax income to net loss to Live Nation: after $195M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $551M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 8.8% to $25.2B in 2025. Operating income rose 51.8% to $1.3B, a 5.0% margin.

The company had a net loss of $54.8M, or −$0.24 per share, versus net income of $638M. Operating cash flow was $1.4B and free cash flow $334M, versus $1.1B; Live Nation returned $23.5M through buybacks.
sources: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

revenueLine.say: Concerts made up 83 percent of revenue.
